sourceInterpretation.logicObserved: The code constructs the local keys array, calls AnimationUtility.SetObjectReferenceCurve, captures preCreateAsset measurements with that keys array, calls AssetDatabase.CreateAsset, then immediately calls ValidateClip. ValidateClip obtains keys from AnimationUtility.GetObjectReferenceCurve(clip, binding) and records those as current.
sourceInterpretation.terminology: preCreateAsset keyCount/firstKeyTime/terminalKeyTime describe the key array requested before CreateAsset; current key fields describe keys read back after CreateAsset. The code does not call LoadAssetAtPath here, so do not describe this as a reload.
